LanguageData.LP_FaithAltar.label: altar
LanguageData.LP_FaithAltar.description: An altar to the colony's patron deity. Here you choose the patron deity, pray (recreation, 1 hour), offer sacrifices for divine favor, craft holy symbols and consecrate holy relics (prayer beads, scarab amulet, purifying seal, circlet of holy light, ring of protective vows); it can link to patron deity statues; with enough divine favor you can also hold the choosing ritual for believers. The altar's light is the color of the patron deity. You can build several.
LanguageData.LP_HolySymbol.label: holy symbol
LanguageData.LP_HolySymbol.description: A silver holy symbol hung on the chest, bearing the mark of the colony's patron deity (without a patron deity the symbol is "silent"). The wearer can cast three common divine spells and the patron deity's domain spell, divine power +0.1; divine magic spends the colony patron deity's divine favor. Useless when worn by the godless.
